content.name: Aditya Kulkarni
content.title: Senior Data Analyst
content.summary: Data analyst with nine years in agri-food MIS, digital payments and omnichannel retail. Lead category and store analytics for a 140-store retail chain, where my markdown analysis protected ₹3.1 crore of margin last festive season. Started in MIS reporting and moved into SQL, Python and Power BI along the way.

experience.title: Senior Data Analyst
bullets: Own category performance analytics for 140 stores and the app, supporting 11 category managers with weekly Power BI packs.
Modelled markdown depth against sell-through during the Diwali season, protecting about ₹3.1 crore in gross margin versus the previous year's blanket discounts.
Set up a store clustering model on footfall and basket mix that now drives planograms for 4 store formats.
Guide two analysts on SQL and presentation skills and review all numbers before they reach leadership.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Monitored UPI and wallet transaction funnels for 6 million monthly users and alerted product teams to drop-offs within a day.
Found that 23% of failed merchant onboardings stalled at KYC document upload; a redesigned flow raised completion by 12 points.
Built a merchant cohort retention report in Metabase that the sales team used to plan ₹45 lakh of incentive spend.

experience.title: MIS Executive
bullets: Compiled daily procurement and dispatch MIS for 3 processing plants and 900 contract farmers.
Replaced manual Excel consolidation with Access macros, saving the plant accounts team 10 hours a week.
Tracked distributor stock ageing and helped reduce expired product write-offs by 17% in one year.

achievements.title: Retail analytics award
achievements.detail: Indrayani Retail Ventures 'Insight of the Year' (2024) for the festive markdown model.

achievements.title: Kaggle notebook
achievements.detail: Published a public notebook on retail demand seasonality that reached the platform's bronze medal tier.
